dialogue.content: こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: The pleasure is all mine. Thank you.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です本日はご相談に来ていただき有難うございます
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: はじめに、ご年齢と性別をおしえていただけますでしょうか
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 25歳 女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 25-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: コロナになってから、何もかもうまくいかないんです
dialogue.English: Ever since the pandemic started, nothing has been going right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはおつらいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 職場は倒産するし、旦那からも当たられるし、辛いです
dialogue.English: My workplace went bankrupt, and my husband takes his frustrations out on me. It's so hard.

dialogue.content: そんなことが、、それは悲しくなってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That's terrible... That must be so upsetting.

dialogue.content: お金も底をついてきて、段々生活も苦しくなって来て。
dialogue.English: Our money is running out, and life is getting harder and harder.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 就職先も決まらないし。
dialogue.English: And I can't find a new job.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 何かもう、生きるのが嫌になってしまいました
dialogue.English: I’ve started to feel like I don’t want to live anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そう思われるのも無理ないと思います
dialogue.English: I see. It’s completely understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 自殺しても解決しないかもしれないけど、かといって、このまま生きていくのも辛い
dialogue.English: Even if I died by suicide it might not solve anything, but living like this is painful too.

dialogue.content: そこまで思い詰めておられるのですね・・・
dialogue.English: You’re feeling that cornered and overwhelmed…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、夫さんに当たられるというのは、どんな感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when you say your husband takes it out on you, what does that look like?

dialogue.content: 暴言はかれたり、たまに手が出たり。
dialogue.English: He uses abusive language, and sometimes he gets physical.

dialogue.content: 物が飛んでくる事もあります
dialogue.English: Sometimes he throws things.

dialogue.content: そんなことが・・・
dialogue.English: That's terrible...

dialogue.content: お怪我とかはありませんでしたか？
dialogue.English: Have you been injured at all?

dialogue.content: ちょっと位はあったけど、大した事ないです
dialogue.English: I've had a few minor injuries, but nothing serious.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは今近くにおられますか？
dialogue.English: Is your husband nearby right now?

dialogue.content: 今は別部屋にいます
dialogue.English: He's in another room right now.

dialogue.content: 調子悪いみたいで、寝てます
dialogue.English: He seems to be feeling unwell, so he's sleeping.

dialogue.content: また暴力を振るわれないか心配ですので、もし夫さんの気配を感じるようなことがあったら
dialogue.English: I'm concerned that he might become violent again, so if you sense that he's nearby...

dialogue.content: 多分当分起きないと思って、LINEしてます
dialogue.English: I’m messaging because I don’t think he’ll wake up for a while.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、今は大丈夫な感じですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you’re safe for the moment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お互いの会社が潰れちゃったんです。
dialogue.English: Both of our companies went out of business.

dialogue.content: えっ・・・夫さんの会社まで・・・
dialogue.English: What... your husband's company too?

dialogue.content: 私は旅行会社・旦那は飲食店
dialogue.English: I was at a travel agency, and my husband was in the restaurant business.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で。
dialogue.English: Because of the pandemic.

dialogue.content: お二人ともが仕事なくなるとは、、ますます苦しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: For both of you to lose your jobs... that must make things even more difficult.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: It does.

dialogue.content: 今はどんなふうにして生活しておられますか
dialogue.English: How are you managing to get by now?

dialogue.content: 雇用保険とか一応あるのと、ある程度の貯金があるので、どうにか
dialogue.English: We have unemployment insurance and some savings, so we’re getting by somehow.

dialogue.content: ただ、それもいつまで続くか分からないと思うと、とても不安になりますよね・・・
dialogue.English: But it must be very worrying to not know how long that will last...

dialogue.content: ただ、2人とも鬱っぽいっていうか…
dialogue.English: It's just that we're both kind of depressed...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 仕事は探しにハローワークに行くけど、なかなかいいのがなくて
dialogue.English: We go to the employment office to look for work, but it’s hard to find anything suitable.

dialogue.content: 落ち込みますよね
dialogue.English: It’s discouraging.

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: It really is.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、先ほど鬱っぽいということでしたが、病院とかには行かれましたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, you mentioned feeling depressed—have you seen a doctor or gone to a clinic?

dialogue.content: それはまだ
dialogue.English: Not yet.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 病院代もかかるし。
dialogue.English: Doctor visits cost money too.

dialogue.content: 生活するのにも苦しいですものね・・
dialogue.English: It’s hard just to make ends meet as it is.

dialogue.content: 条件が難しいんです
dialogue.English: The conditions are difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いいなと思うと、地方転勤必須だったり。
dialogue.English: When I find a job I like, it requires relocating to another region.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 実はコロナ前に、マンション買ったばかりで
dialogue.English: Actually, we had just bought a condo right before the pandemic.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.English: Oh, you did...

dialogue.content: それは困りますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That complicates things, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: 住宅ローンも安かったし、お互いそれなりに収入があったから、どうにかなるかと思ってたのに
dialogue.English: The mortgage was affordable and we both had decent incomes, so we thought we’d manage somehow, but…

dialogue.content: それがコロナのせいで・・・
dialogue.English: But then because of the pandemic...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 落ち込むのも当たり前だと思います
dialogue.English: It's perfectly normal to feel down about that.

dialogue.content: 事情が事情だし、色々申請したからまだ住めるけど、それもいつまで続くか…
dialogue.English: Because of our circumstances, we applied for various assistance programs, so we can still live here for now, but I don't know for how long...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 不安が押し寄せてきますよね・・
dialogue.English: The anxiety must feel overwhelming.

dialogue.content: 旦那はもともと短期な所があるけど、家にお互いいると、イライラするのか、小言も言うし。
dialogue.English: My husband has always had a short temper, but with both of us at home, I guess he gets irritated. He nags and complains.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 料理まずいとか掃除出来てない位なら、まだいいけど
dialogue.English: If it were just complaining that the food is bad or the house isn't clean, that would be one thing.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 「お前のせいで」みたいな事言われると、堪えます
dialogue.English: But when he says things like, "This is all your fault," it really gets to me.

dialogue.content: そんなこと言われたら悲しくなりますよね・・・
dialogue.English: It must be so sad to be told something like that...

dialogue.content: 確かにマンション購入は、私の方が積極的だったけど、旦那も気にいって買ったんだし。
dialogue.English: It's true I was more proactive about buying the condo, but he liked it too and we bought it together.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私のせいばかりにされても…
dialogue.English: For him to put all the blame on me...

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, that's really unfair.

dialogue.content: よろしければ、何とお呼びしたらいいか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable with it, could you tell me what I should call you?

dialogue.content: ひとみです
dialogue.English: It's Hitomi.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんですね、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Hitomi, thank you.

dialogue.content: マンションで、同じ位の収入の家族が、何人か退去しているんです。
dialogue.English: In our condo building, several families with similar incomes have already moved out.

dialogue.content: それは不安になりますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That must make you feel anxious...

dialogue.content: 賃貸貸しにする方もいれば、お仕事の関係で、売却された方もいて。
dialogue.English: Some are renting out their places, while others have sold them due to work.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私はそこまで踏ん切りつかない。気にいって買ったし。
dialogue.English: I can't bring myself to do that. I really love this place we bought.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、思い入れのある家ですものね・・・
dialogue.English: Of course. It's a home you have a deep attachment to.

dialogue.content: だからといって、どうしたらいいのか…
dialogue.English: But even so, I don't know what to do...

dialogue.content: 現実をみるのが辛すぎるんです
dialogue.English: It’s too painful to face reality.

dialogue.content: 何もかも手放さないといけないのかと思いと。
dialogue.English: When I think I might have to give up everything…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: コロナ前と現実と比べると、あまりにも差がひどくて
dialogue.English: When I compare reality now to how things were before the pandemic, the difference is too stark.

dialogue.content: 旦那もコロナで仕事失ってから、あんな態度になってきて
dialogue.English: My husband started acting like that after he lost his job due to COVID.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 前は優しかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was he kind before?

dialogue.content: 優しいというか…頼もしい感じでした
dialogue.English: Not exactly kind... more like dependable.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: バイタリティーがあって、筋が一本通っている感じ
dialogue.English: He had vitality and a strong sense of conviction.

dialogue.content: テレビみてると、「コロナ前には戻らない」とか言うじゃないですか。
dialogue.English: When I watch TV, they say things like, "We'll never go back to the way things were before COVID."

dialogue.content: とても頼りにしていたのですね、それが今はがらっと変わってしまって・・・
dialogue.English: You really relied on him, and now he has changed so drastically...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 戻らないなら、どうなるんだろうと
dialogue.English: If things won't go back, I wonder what will happen.

dialogue.content: 先が見えない
dialogue.English: I can’t see the future.

dialogue.content: とても心細いですよね・・・
dialogue.English: That must feel very lonely and helpless...

dialogue.content: お互い不安で
dialogue.English: We’re both anxious.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どうすればいいのか…
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to do…

dialogue.content: 一緒にどうすればいいか考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Let's think about what to do together.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんだったら、どうしますか？
dialogue.English: If you were me, counselor, what would you do?

dialogue.content: 本当に出口の見えない中で、耐えておられると思います　本当にすごいと私は感じました
dialogue.English: I believe you’ve been enduring so much with no clear way out. I truly think that’s remarkable.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんと夫さんは今職を失っておられます
dialogue.English: Hitomi, you and your husband have lost your jobs.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 生活苦の中でなんとか年金と貯金で生活しておられます
dialogue.English: Amidst financial hardship, you are somehow living on unemployment benefits and savings.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ですが、マンションのローンなども抱え先の見えない中で、現実を見るのがとても辛い状況です
dialogue.English: However, you also have the condo mortgage, and with an uncertain future, it's a very painful situation to face reality.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このような状況の中で、毎日を必死で生きているひとみさんは本当に頑張っていると思います
dialogue.English: In this situation, I think you’re doing an incredible job just getting through each day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも疲れました
dialogue.English: But I’m tired.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: そうなるもの無理ないですよね・・
dialogue.English: It’s no wonder you feel that way.

dialogue.content: 結構限界です
dialogue.English: I’m pretty much at my limit.

dialogue.content: もう消えてしまいたいとか考えたりしますか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever think about wanting to disappear?

dialogue.content: 無理ないというなら、どうすれば？
dialogue.English: If you say it's natural, then what should I do?

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Let’s think it through together.

dialogue.content: 消えてらくになれるなら、そうしたいと思う事もあります
dialogue.English: Sometimes I think if I could disappear and be at peace, I’d want to.

dialogue.content: どう考えてくださるんですか？
dialogue.English: How will you think this through with me?

dialogue.content: さっきから、そう書いてるけど。
dialogue.English: You keep saying that.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談員の方を問い詰めても仕方ないけど
dialogue.English: I know it's no use grilling you, the counselor.

dialogue.content: 結局他人だしとか思ってしまって
dialogue.English: But I can't help but think you're just a stranger.

dialogue.content: わかりっこないとか
dialogue.English: That you couldn’t possibly understand.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I hear you.

dialogue.content: 人と比べて、余計鬱っぽくなる
dialogue.English: Comparing myself to others makes me feel even more depressed.

dialogue.content: とにかく生活をどうにかしたいとは思うけど、気力がわかない
dialogue.English: I want to sort out our life somehow, but I can’t summon the energy.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか分からなくなりますよね・・・
dialogue.English: It’s hard to know what to do, isn’t it.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんもですか
dialogue.English: You too, counselor?

dialogue.content: いいえそうではありませんが、
dialogue.English: No, that's not what I mean, but...

dialogue.content: ひとみさんのお辛い気持ちがとても伝わってきます
dialogue.English: I can really feel how painful this is for you, Hitomi.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私から一つだけお伝えしたいことがあるのですがよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: May I share just one thing with you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本当に耐え忍んで毎日を生きておられるひとみさんご自身に
dialogue.English: To you, Hitomi, who are truly enduring and getting through each day—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずは身体を温めてあげて欲しいのです温かいお風呂に入ったり、温かい飲み物を飲んだりして欲しいのですそしてひとみさん自身を大切に大切にしてあげてくださいそうすることで、少し心が落ち着くと思うのですがいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: First, I want you to warm your body. I'd like you to take a warm bath or drink a warm beverage. And please, take very good care of yourself. I believe that by doing so, your mind will feel a little calmer. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: はい、心と身体は繋がっているので、温めてあげるだけでも少し心が落ち着くと思うのです
dialogue.English: Yes. The mind and body are connected, so even just warming your body can help your mind feel a bit calmer.

dialogue.content: お風呂は好きで、長めに入っています。お風呂の中で寝る事もあります
dialogue.English: I like baths, and I take long ones. Sometimes I even fall asleep in the tub.

dialogue.content: 温かい飲み物も毎日飲んでます
dialogue.English: I also drink warm beverages every day.

dialogue.content: コロナ対策で緑茶がいいと聞いたので。
dialogue.English: I heard green tea is good for preventing COVID.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 朝が一番鬱っぽいんです。また1日が始まると思うと嫌で。
dialogue.English: I feel most depressed in the morning. I hate the thought of a new day starting.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 夜はお風呂入って、ホッとしてそのまま眠れます。
dialogue.English: At night, I take a bath, feel relieved, and can fall right asleep.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうして、是非身体を温めてひとみさん自身をいたわってあげてください本日のご相談はこれで終了とさせていただきたいと思いますがよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Please continue to do that, to warm your body and be kind to yourself. I'd like to conclude our session for today, if that's okay with you.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 是非また何かありましたら、相談にお越しください
dialogue.English: Please, if anything comes up, don't hesitate to come back for another session.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: それでは相談の方終了させていただきます本日はご相談ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Then we’ll end the session here. Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした！有難うございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work! Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （大変勉強になりました）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: （失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Thank you for your efforts.

dialogue.content: 感想はまたレポートで書きますね
dialogue.English: I'll write my feedback in the report later.

dialogue.content: はい、どうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please do. Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは終了させていただきますね
dialogue.English: Alright, I'll end the session now.

dialogue.content: 了解しました
dialogue.English: Understood.
